title: A DNA methylation signature identified in the buccal mucosa reflecting active tuberculosis is changing during tuberculosis treatment.
summary: A DNA-methylation signature in buccal samples is associated with active tuberculosis and changes during treatment, a measured molecular result linked to model-based signature selection.
ai_technology: Primary study uses clinical cohorts including active TB and longitudinal treatment samples; methylation measures and signature classification are compared.

evidence.tested: A DNA-methylation signature in buccal samples is associated with active tuberculosis and changes during treatment, a measured molecular result linked to model-based signature selection.
evidence.unknown: Cohort and treatment sampling support association, not causal mechanism or a validated standalone test.
evidence.ai_role: Primary study uses clinical cohorts including active TB and longitudinal treatment samples; methylation measures and signature classification are compared.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
